Control Flames
Action

Shape, expand, or extinguish a visible nonmagical flame in a 5-foot cube within 60 ft.; no slot.

Manual ruling · Exact effect, targets, timing and any material or situational requirements need a DM ruling. The text is available; automation is not claimed.
Mage Hand
Action

Create and control a spectral hand within 30 ft.; no slot.

Manual ruling · Exact effect, targets, timing and any material or situational requirements need a DM ruling. The text is available; automation is not claimed.
Ice Knife
Action · +8 to hit · 1d10 piercing + cold · DC 16 DEX

Ranged spell attack, 60 ft.; piercing on hit, then target and creatures within 5 ft. make a Dexterity save or take 2d6 cold.

Quick roll only
Roll damage
Choose details · Resolve the attack and a separately selected burst, even on a miss. Only piercing attack dice double on a critical.
Ice Knife burst
After Ice Knife · 2d6 cold · DC 15 DEX

Cold burst after the knife attack. Target and all creatures within 5 ft. make Dexterity save DC 14; no extra spell slot.

Roll damage
Manual ruling · Use the combined Ice Knife review to avoid repeating its burst or spending another slot.
Magic Missile
Action · 1d4+1 force

Three darts at creatures within 120 ft.; no attack roll. Each dart deals force damage.

Roll damage
Choose details · Allocate every dart; confirm visibility, range and any Shield. One slot pays for the entire spell.
Mage Armor
Action

Touch an unarmored willing creature; base AC becomes 13 + Dexterity modifier for 8 hours. Aldric’s AC becomes 15.

Manual ruling · Exact effect, targets, timing and any material or situational requirements need a DM ruling. The text is available; automation is not claimed.
Shield
Reaction

+5 AC until the start of Aldric’s next turn; blocks Magic Missile.

Choose details · Confirm the triggering attack or Magic Missile. Reaction, slot, +5 AC and expiry are reviewed together.
Silvery Barbs
Reaction

When a visible creature within 60 ft. succeeds on an attack, check, or save: force a reroll and use the lower d20; grant another visible creature advantage on one roll within 1 minute.

Manual ruling · Exact effect, targets, timing and any material or situational requirements need a DM ruling. The text is available; automation is not claimed.
Aganazzar’s Scorcher
Action · 3d8 fire · DC 16 DEX

Fire in a 30-foot line, 5 feet wide; Dexterity save DC 14 for half. Sculpt Spells may protect up to three visible creatures.

Roll damage
Choose details · Select every creature in the line. Explicitly choose eligible Sculpt Spells exclusions; Dexterity save for half.
Web
Action · DC 16 DEX

20-foot cube within 60 feet; concentration up to 1 hour. Creatures entering or starting there make Dexterity save DC 14 or become restrained; see spell for escape and fire.

Manual ruling · Exact effect, targets, timing and any material or situational requirements need a DM ruling. The text is available; automation is not claimed.

Arcane Recovery
After short rest

Once per day after a short rest, recover spell slots with combined level 2 or less: one 2nd-level slot or two 1st-level slots.

Choose details · Confirm a short rest and choose expended slots. Donavan can recover one slot level; Aldric two.
